sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a bee character. Draw this exact bee as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the fuzzy yellow-and-brown striped round body with its little stinger, without head, wings or legs.
2. the head: the round fuzzy yellow head, facing left as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; no antennae.
3. one antenna: a thin brown curled antenna with a round tip.
4. one wing: a clear pale wing with thin veins, as the big wing in image 1, with a rounded root.
5. one leg: a little dark bent leg.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a bee character; image 2 shows the same bee cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the bee's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the bee in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the bee's left eye (on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a big dark round eye with a white sparkle.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile.
7. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
8. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
9. the mouth in a small sad frown.
10. the nose as it is in image 1: a tiny dark brown rounded-triangle nose.
11. one eyebrow as in image 1: a small, thin, softly curved brown line.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the bee takes a deep breath and hums a happy tune with her eyes closed, wings buzzing, then does a little waggle dance with her striped bottom and smiles.

pause.shows: the bee humming with her eyes closed, wings buzzing

animations.description: the bee buzzes along to the left, wings a blur, bobbing a little, then hovers in place.
the bee zooms round in a little loop-the-loop, turns round to look the other way, turns back and buzzes happily.
the bee does her waggle dance: she wiggles her striped bottom as she buzzes forward in a line, loops back round and wiggles along again, to show her friends the way to the flowers.
the bee zips up high for joy and bobs back down with a happy wiggle.
the bee shakes its head no.
the bee looks one way, then the other, then back.
the bee laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles.
the bee does a happy little dance in the air, swaying from side to side and kicking her little legs.
the bee talks, its mouth moving, its head bobbing a little.
the bee shivers and trembles, cold or scared.
the bee cries, head down, her little body shaking with sobs.
the bee gives a big yawn, closes her eyes and dozes as she hovers, wings slowing to a lazy flutter, then wakes up with a start and smiles.

pause.shows: the bee asleep in the air, eyes shut, head drooped, wings fluttering lazily

animations.description: the bee lifts a little front leg and waves hello.
the bee twirls right round in the air.
the bee hovers and beats her wings extra fast, puffing hard to fan up a cool breeze, then slows down and smiles.
